usedFor: TimeLive holds projects, tasks and employees, and HubSpot opens a deal for them through “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Project” in TimeLive, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A new project marks work that is starting, and the action opens a deal to match.

watchOut: The deal for “New Project” in TimeLive appears after a scheduled check, because that trigger is polling.
